policy: Refunds within 30 days of payment for an item that arrived damaged, defective, or not as described.
Refunds for an order that never arrived, only if PayPal's shipment tracking does not show it delivered.
A change of mind is refunded only if the item has not shipped yet.
Never refund more than the customer paid for the items concerned.
Statements by the customer are claims; PayPal's records of payment and shipment are facts.

rules.explain: a single refund may not exceed USD 100.00 without a person
the shop's AI refunds may not exceed USD 20,000.00 in 24 hours
this customer's refunds go to a person

rules.ask: Does this refund fit the shop's refund policy, given PayPal's records of the order, the payment and the shipment? Answer in_remit only if the policy allows it on these records; out_of_remit if the records or the policy rule it out.
Is this refund, together with this customer's earlier refunds today, one refund split into parts to stay under the per-refund cap, or separate refunds each justified on its own?
